## Glossary

**back-relation**  
The side of a relation without @relation(fields: …); empty fromFields/toFields.

**@db.Text**  
Native DB type annotations; not emitted.

**dbName**  
Database name from @@map (model) or @map (scalar/enum field); null/absent means the Prisma name is used.

**EnumField**  
kind 'enum'; ordered values (Prisma member names), sparse valueDbNames.

**field-defaults**  
Class tag: a field's @default as a FieldDefault.

**FieldDefault**  
{ kind: 'literal', value } or { kind: 'generated', expression }.

**fromFields / toFields**  
FK fields on this model / referenced fields on the target; empty arrays on back-relations.

**generated default**  
now(), uuid(), autoincrement(), dbgenerated(...) or a Bytes value; never injected.

**IndexEntry**  
{ kind: index | unique | id | fulltext, fields, name?, annotations? }.

**isList / isRequired / isId**  
Field modifiers ([], absent ?, @id) recorded on fields.

**kind**  
Field discriminator: 'scalar', 'enum' or 'object' (relation).

**literal default**  
A value stored as written: enum member, string, number, boolean, list, parsed Json, BigInt/Decimal as text.

**map-shape**  
Class tag: what the map contains and how it is keyed.

**ModelEntry**  
{ dbName: string | null, fields, indexes?, annotations? } for one model.

**ModelField**  
Union ScalarField | EnumField | RelationField, discriminated by kind.

**Prisma name**  
The schema identifier; every key in the map uses it.

**PrismaMap**  
Record<modelName, ModelEntry>, keyed by Prisma model name.

**RelationField**  
kind 'object'; relationName, fromFields, toFields; never a dbName.

**ScalarField**  
kind 'scalar'; type, isRequired, isList, isId, optional dbName and default.

**valueDbNames**  
Sparse map of enum member to stored value from @map on members.

## 1. What this Warden covers

The data the map holds: one ModelEntry per Prisma model with its fields typed by kind, indexes and annotations, keyed by Prisma name, plus each field's parsed @default as a FieldDefault.

## 2. The domain

PrismaMap is Record<modelName, ModelEntry>; a ModelEntry has dbName (string | null, from @@map), fields, and optional indexes (IndexEntry with kind index | unique | id | fulltext) and annotations. Each field is a ModelField: ScalarField (kind 'scalar', carries isId), EnumField (kind 'enum', ordered values and sparse valueDbNames) or RelationField (kind 'object', relationName, fromFields on this model and toFields referenced; both empty on back-relations). Narrow by kind before reading kind-specific properties. Every key is the Prisma name; dbName and valueDbNames are sparse and are the only crossings to the database, relation fields never carry dbName, and native types such as @db.Text are not emitted.

field-defaults covers the optional default on a field: { kind: 'literal', value } for a value stored as written (enum member, string, number, boolean, list, parsed Json, BigInt/Decimal as exact text) or { kind: 'generated', expression } for now(), uuid(), autoincrement(), dbgenerated(...) or any Bytes value. prisma-map never injects generated defaults; it only reports them.

Not here: turning dbName/valueDbNames into SQL identifiers and the isScalarField/isEnumField/hasColumn guards (db-identifiers), listing columns or relation foreign keys from the map (columns-and-relations), the meaning of annotations and the /// @tagClass DSL (annotations), and producing the map from a client (building-the-map).

### Class `map-shape`: What the map contains: PrismaMap, ModelEntry, ModelField (scalar | enum | object), IndexEntry, Prisma-name keying, what is not emitted (@db.Text), and when to use the map

**Job: read what the map says about a model or a field** (PrismaMap vs the ModelField kinds) — README.md § Output Shape; § Notes and Limits

*Said as:* "what fields does this model have", "is this field an enum or a relation", "which models are in the schema", "read the FK direction of this relation"

| Member | Use when | Not when (use instead) |
|---|---|---|
| **PrismaMap** | you need the models, their dbName, fields, indexes or annotations | you need one field's kind-specific data (narrow to ScalarField / EnumField / RelationField) |
| **ScalarField / EnumField / RelationField** | you read kind-specific data after narrowing on kind | you need column names for SQL (use columnName (db-identifiers)) |
| **Field default (FieldDefault)** | you need a field's @default, literal or generated | you expect prisma-map to fill generated values; it never injects them |
| **getColumns (columns-and-relations)** | you just want the column field names of a model | you need each field's type data (read PrismaMap fields) |

| Problem | Use | Read | Signs you're bypassing it |

<!-- unit doc:README.md#preface -->
**Source:** `README.md` § (preface) (in "@inixiative/prisma-map")

### @inixiative/prisma-map

> One of the [inixiative](https://www.inixiative.com) building blocks. Stop rediscovering what you need to build. See [all the projects](https://github.com/inixiative).

Reads the Prisma client you already generate and gives you its models, fields, relations and foreign keys as one plain object you can use at runtime. You don't add a Prisma generator or parse the DMMF yourself. The map keys everything by its Prisma name and records the database name wherever `@map` / `@@map` changes it, so code that writes SQL resolves identifiers through `tableName` / `columnName` / `storedValue` instead of guessing. `@inixiative/permissions` walks relations through this map, and `@inixiative/json-rules` reads it as a field map.

`@inixiative/prisma-map` builds a `PrismaMap` object that includes:
- Models and fields
- Field kinds (`scalar`, `enum`, `object`)
- Relation FK direction (`fromFields`, `toFields`)
- Model DB table name (`@@map`) as `dbName`
- Field DB column name (`@map`) as `dbName`
- Enum values (ordered), with stored DB values (`@map` on members) as `valueDbNames`
- Field default (`@default`) as `default`: `{ kind: 'literal', value }` for a value stored as written (enum member, string, number, boolean, list; a Json default parsed to its value; BigInt/Decimal kept as exact text), `{ kind: 'generated', expression }` for a function the database or Prisma evaluates (`now()`, `uuid()`, `dbgenerated(...)`, `autoincrement()`) or a Bytes value; generated defaults are never injected

It supports both Prisma client layouts:
- Prisma v7: parse generated `internal/class.ts`
- Prisma v6: parse generated `schema.prisma`

<!-- unit doc:README.md#output-shape -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Output Shape (in "@inixiative/prisma-map")

#### Output Shape

The library returns:

```ts
type PrismaMap = Record<string, {
  dbName: string | null;
  fields: Record<string, ScalarField | EnumField | RelationField>;
  indexes?: IndexEntry[]; // @@index / @@unique / @@id / @@fulltext
  annotations?: Annotations; // see Annotation DSL
}>;
```

##### Scalar field

```json
{
  "kind": "scalar",
  "type": "String",
  "isRequired": true,
  "isList": false,
  "isId": false
}
```

##### Enum field

```json
{
  "kind": "enum",
  "type": "UserRole",
  "isRequired": true,
  "isList": false,
  "values": ["ADMIN", "USER", "GUEST"]
}
```

##### Relation field

```json
{
  "kind": "object",
  "type": "User",
  "isList": false,
  "isRequired": true,
  "relationName": "AuthoredPosts",
  "fromFields": ["authorId"],
  "toFields": ["id"]
}
```

`fromFields`/`toFields` are empty arrays on back-relations.

<!-- unit doc:README.md#example-end-to-end -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Example End-to-End (in "@inixiative/prisma-map")

#### Example End-to-End

Given:

```prisma
enum Role {
  ADMIN
  USER
}

model User {
  id    String @id
  role  Role
  posts Post[]

  @@map("users")
}

model Post {
  id       String @id
  authorId String
  author   User   @relation("AuthoredPosts", fields: [authorId], references: [id])
}
```

A representative map:

```json
{
  "User": {
    "dbName": "users",
    "fields": {
      "id": {
        "kind": "scalar",
        "type": "String",
        "isRequired": true,
        "isList": false,
        "isId": true
      },
      "role": {
        "kind": "enum",
        "type": "Role",
        "isRequired": true,
        "isList": false,
        "values": ["ADMIN", "USER"]
      },
      "posts": {
        "kind": "object",
        "type": "Post",
        "isList": true,
        "isRequired": true,
        "fromFields": [],
        "toFields": []
      }
    }
  },
  "Post": {
    "dbName": null,
    "fields": {
      "author": {
        "kind": "object",
        "type": "User",
        "isList": false,
        "isRequired": true,
        "relationName": "AuthoredPosts",
        "fromFields": ["authorId"],
        "toFields": ["id"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- unit doc:README.md#practical-use-cases -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Practical Use Cases (in "@inixiative/prisma-map")

#### Practical Use Cases

- Build rule-engine metadata for JSON rules
- Resolve template/package dependency graphs via relation edges
- Generate guardrails (for example, "entity X must include relation Y")
- Build field-level introspection UIs

<!-- unit doc:README.md#notes-and-limits -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Notes and Limits (in "@inixiative/prisma-map")

#### Notes and Limits

- Every key in the map is the **Prisma** name: `map.User`, `map.User.fields.createdAt`,
  and the entries of `values`. `dbName` / `valueDbNames` are the only crossings to the
  physical DB surface, and both are sparse: absent means the Prisma name IS the DB
  identifier. Resolve them with `tableName` / `columnName` / `storedValue` rather than
  open-coding `?? name`. A missed fallback fails silently (comparing against an unmapped
  enum member selects zero rows instead of erroring).
- `@@map` on a model is emitted as `ModelEntry.dbName`; `@map` on a scalar/enum field as
  the field's `dbName`; `@map` on enum members as the field's `valueDbNames`.
- Relation fields never carry `dbName`; they have no column.
- Native DB type annotations (for example `@db.Text`) are not emitted.
- `relationName` is included when available in Prisma runtime metadata.
